records.name: Change The Future
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Change The Future under PQ43 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Take a counter stance against incoming Ki attacks; when struck, move to the opponent and fire a Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: The current Xenoverse 2 reference documents the trigger as basic Ki Blasts or Ki Blast skills, with invulnerability during the movement portion. The in-game description's reference to Strike attacks is treated as a documented description error rather than the actual counter type.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ43 is the documented Future Warrior route and Change The Future is a Basic Reward. No unsupported drop probability is recorded.
records.pve_notes: The skill can counter Ki Blast pressure and is documented as a PQ43 Basic Reward.
records.pvp_notes: Its documented counter target is Ki Blast attacks. Exact frame, matchup, and version-specific behavior remain unresolved.
